root: ^The man stands in the shadows of the room, his eyes cold as he watches the ballroom.

g-0: ^"You have the look of someone gathering intelligence. Join the club."

intel_talk: ^"Everyone here is trying to figure out Alistair's next move." He lets out a bitter laugh.

g-0: ^"The man's made enemies of half the nobility, but we're all too afraid to act against him."
g-1: ^"He has documents, you see. Secrets that can bury a family in a single afternoon."

step_2: ^"You sound like you have personal experience."
experience_talk: ^"He ruined my brother five years ago over a business dispute. Destroyed him completely."

g-0: ^He stares darkly at the crowd. "Cornellius helped, actually. Delivered the killing blow in court with that silver tongue of his."
g-1: ^"I've watched that protégé of Alistair's carefully ever since. The student's learning well—maybe too well."
g-2: ^"Sometimes I think Cornellius is even more dangerous than his master."

hope_talk: ^"Hope?" He laughs, though there is no humor in it. "I hope Alistair chokes on his champagne. I hope someone finally stands up to him."

g-0: ^"Brooklyn has the spirit for it, but not the proof. Flora has the rage, but not the means."
g-1: ^"Derek has the strength, but not the freedom. And Gaten?"
g-2: ^He scoffs. "That boy couldn't stand up to a stiff breeze. If anything's going to change, it won't be tonight."
